name: Bracon! Nazusa Onee-chan no Seikatsu Hogo
original_name: ブラコン!なずさおねーちゃんの性活保護
source:
My big sister just became the school nurse at the very academy I attend. Concerned by my crippling shyness and utter lack of female attention, she resolves to remedy my plight — offering herself as my personal tutor in the carnal arts.
Thus begins our lascivious campus life together, a clandestine curriculum of forbidden lessons whispered between siblings.

[Translated from the [url=http://lyricbox.jp/BRACON/]official site[/url]]
translation:
我的姐姐刚刚成为我就读的学院的学校护士。由于担心我极度害羞和完全缺乏女性关注，她决定解决我的困境——担任我的私人艺术导师。
就这样，我们一起开始了淫荡的校园生活，兄弟姐妹之间窃窃私语的秘密禁忌课程。

[翻译自[url=http://lyricbox.jp/BRACON/]官方网站[/url]]
